Frequently asked questions

Can’t find what you’re looking for? Our Help Centre has more answers.

Need more help? →
How do I set up my Azaremit account?

Create an account on the Azaremit web or mobile app, enter your details and follow the steps to verify your identity. Once your account is verified and approved, you can get started with sending money.

Which countries can I send money to?

Azaremit supports transfers through selected corridors, with payouts in NGN, GHS, XOF and XAF. We’re adding more currencies and destinations soon.

How much are the transfer fees on Azaremit?

Azaremit is designed to make sending money simpler, with no transfer fees. The exchange rate applies to your transfer, so you can review the amount your recipient will receive before confirming.

How will my recipient receive the money?

Your recipient can receive money through available payout methods, such as supported bank accounts or mobile money services, depending on the destination.

Is Azaremit regulated and safe to use?

Azaremit is powered by Payaza, whose entities are registered with relevant financial authorities in the markets where they operate. These include FINTRAC in Canada, FinCEN in the United States, AUSTRAC in Australia, and the Financial Service Providers Register in New Zealand.

We take security and compliance seriously, with measures designed to help protect your transactions and personal information.
